newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - 360 Communications view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - 360 Communications view cut.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Wednesday it lowered its earnings per share estimates on 360 Communications Co to $0.68 from $0.77 for 1997 and to $1.16 from $1.22 for 1998.
-- It also lowered its EBITDA estimate by $20 milion to $477 million for 1997 and by $10 million to $617 million for 1998.

-- In a report, EVEREN noted that 360's strong subscriber growth numbers and elevated fraud during Q1 were anticipated, but the lower average revenue per user per month was not, thus providing for lower than anticipated EBITDA.
